Le passage de l'intelligence artificiell: The transition from generative artificial intelligence to physical AI
Durant la conférence annuelle GTC au Tem: During the annual GTC conference at the Tempodrom in Berlin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addressed small duck-shaped robots on stage, illustrating the technological industry's advancements. While generative artificial intelligence such as ChatGPT or DeepSeek remains confined to screens to process and generate text, code, or images, physical AI integrates intelligence models into hardware machines such as autonomous vehicles, mechanical arms, and humanoid robots.
Ces systèmes perçoivent l'environnement: These systems perceive the real environment through sensors, incorporate physical laws such as gravity and friction, and adjust their movements live. Robotics is thus moving away from rigid line-by-line programming in favor of autonomous learning capable of handling the unexpected.
L'adoption du format humanoïde répond à: The adoption of the humanoid format responds to practical motivations. On one hand, workshops, factories, and work tools having been designed by and for humans, using a bipedal robot makes it possible to exploit current infrastructures without major development costs. On the other hand, the humanoid robot offers a standardization comparable to that of the smartphone, which acts as a universal platform for applications.
L'expérience menée avec le robot Microdu: The experiment conducted with the Microduck robot, designed in collaboration with Hugging Face and the French start-up Pollen Robotics, validated this approach. Autonomous AI agents built the virtual environment, trained the robots to jump, and then transferred the code directly into the physical machines.
Le PDG de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, a présen: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang presented the company's vision on physical AI during the annual GTC conference at the Tempodrom in Berlin.
L'IA physique se distingue de l'IA génér: Physical AI differs from generative AI by being embedded in hardware machines capable of interacting with the real world.
Le choix du format humanoïde permet d'ut: The choice of the humanoid format makes it possible to use existing industrial infrastructures and offer a standardized platform.
Nvidia structure son approche à travers: Nvidia structures its approach through intensive computing, ultra-realistic simulation via digital twins, and Sim-to-Real transfer.
Le robot Microduck, développé avec Polle: The Microduck robot, developed with Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face, served as a practical demonstration of this method.
